name: CBESS Student Researcher Program
org: University of Nevada, Reno Raggio Research Center
what_you_do: Spend a week on campus plus 2 or more weeks online in a summer research program. Then plan a student led research project on a community health issue.
who_can_apply: Bilingual English and Spanish high school juniors in Northern Nevada. Up to 30 are chosen for the summer program.
pay_detail: Free to attend. A stipend is not mentioned.
duration: One week on campus plus two or more weeks virtual, then monthly mentoring in senior year
deadline_text: No deadline or dates posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Fill out the CBESS Interest Form at nevada.formstack.com/forms/cbess. Questions: cbess@unr.edu or (775) 784-1110.
notes: Chosen students also do an outreach internship. Up to 64 more juniors get a certificate. They must first finish some questionnaires.
